episodes.title: Pilot
episodes.summary: In the wake of tragedy, LBPD training officer Traci Harmon takes on new trainee, Alex Diaz who on day one is already learning the job is harder than he imagined.

episodes.title: Laws of the Universe
episodes.summary: A chaotic street takeover finds our officers grossly outnumbered, revealing philosophical rifts inside West Division.

episodes.title: South of Heaven
episodes.summary: Diaz learns that Harmon has enemies within West Division, and begins to fear she cannot be trusted.

episodes.title: Unsung
episodes.summary: Desperate for a lead, Harmon goes off book resulting in a major breakthrough and a deadly showdown.

episodes.title: Not Your Savior
episodes.summary: Back on patrol, the rift between Harmon and Diaz comes to a head.

episodes.title: L.A. Woman
episodes.summary: When Diaz's family is threatened, Harmon realizes she must break her own rules to fix it.

episodes.title: War Machine
episodes.summary: A shot caller's revenge mission results in West Division going head to head with an entire gang.

episodes.title: How the West Was Won
episodes.summary: Harmon and Diaz join forces with an elite squad to intercept a major drug shipment.
